1	function [accept, d2] = measurement_gate(y, S, gamma)
2	%MEASUREMENT_GATE  Measurement validation gate (CVT-SRS-003 Rev C, section 7.3).
3	%
4	%   [accept, d2] = measurement_gate(y, S, gamma)
5	%
6	%   y      m-by-1 innovation vector.
7	%   S      m-by-m innovation covariance (symmetric positive definite).
8	%   gamma  scalar gate threshold (chi-squared critical value, resolved from
9	%          configuration by the caller; the gate holds no threshold, G3).
10	%   accept logical scalar: true iff the measurement passes the gate.
11	%   d2     normalized innovation squared, d2 = y' * inv(S) * y (7.3.1).
12	%
13	%   The measurement is admitted iff d2 <= gamma (G2). d2 is computed by
14	%   solving S x = y; inv(S) is never formed (G1).
15	%
16	%   Fail closed (G4, G-BC-1/G-BC-2): if y or S has a non-finite element, or
17	%   gamma is not a finite positive scalar, the gate returns accept = false and
18	%   d2 = Inf without raising an error. The same rejecting result is returned
19	%   for any other input that is outside the 7.3.4 contract and so cannot
20	%   yield a trustworthy d2: non-numeric or complex data, a y that is not a
21	%   column vector, an S whose size does not match y, or an S that is not
22	%   symmetric positive definite (including numerically singular S).
23	%
24	%   The function is pure: no file access, no printing, no globals.
25	
26	  accept = false;
27	  d2 = Inf;
28	
29	  % --- threshold (G-BC-1) ---
30	  if ~(isnumeric(gamma) && isreal(gamma) && isscalar(gamma))
31	    return;
32	  end
33	  gamma = double(gamma);
34	  if ~(isfinite(gamma) && gamma > 0)
35	    return;
36	  end
37	
38	  % --- measurement shape and type (malformed => reject, R6) ---
39	  if ~(isnumeric(y) && isreal(y) && isnumeric(S) && isreal(S))
40	    return;
41	  end
42	  if ndims(y) ~= 2 || ndims(S) ~= 2
43	    return;
44	  end
45	  m = size(y, 1);
46	  if m < 1 || size(y, 2) ~= 1 || ~isequal(size(S), [m, m])
47	    return;
48	  end
49	  y = double(y);
50	  S = double(S);
51	
52	  % --- non-finite values (G-BC-1) ---
53	  if ~(all(isfinite(y)) && all(isfinite(S(:))))
54	    return;
55	  end
56	
57	  % --- S must be symmetric positive definite (7.3.1 precondition) ---
58	  if norm(S - S', 'fro') > sqrt(eps) * norm(S, 'fro')
59	    return;
60	  end
61	  [~, notpd] = chol(S);
62	  if notpd ~= 0
63	    return;
64	  end
65	
66	  % --- NIS (7.3.1, G1): solve S x = y, d2 = y' * x ---
67	  % Warnings (e.g. "matrix singular to machine precision") are silenced for
68	  % the solve and restored afterwards so the gate never prints; a
69	  % numerically singular S is caught by the finiteness check below or by
70	  % the rcond check.
71	  wstate = warning();
72	  restore = onCleanup(@() warning(wstate));
73	  warning('off', 'all');
74	  if rcond(S) < eps
75	    return;
76	  end
77	  x = S \ y;
78	  d = y' * x;
79	  if ~(isfinite(d) && d >= 0)
80	    return;
81	  end
82	
83	  % --- gate decision (7.3.2, G2) ---
84	  d2 = d;
85	  accept = (d2 <= gamma);
86	end
87
